Ym.bar_b_note: B's thatched pavilion, stall and hut give the place a focus, but the bare featureless dunes, flat banded navy water and lack of haze or groves read far below Palworld density and Valheim atmosphere.

Kg.bar_b_note: The trees and blue-banner camp help, and B's cleared sand path reads authored, but the location is still a tiny kiosk on open sand with flat lighting and no depth haze.

Gk.bar_b_note: The smooth vertical sand wall at stand 09 and the even pebble scatter at stand 10 sink it, even though B's watchtower and hillside hut add a focus.

Ml.bar_b_note: The clean, appealing elder with a strong white hair-and-beard silhouette and an earthy green-brown outfit reaches shipping stylised finish, held back only by flat stage light and slightly generic cartoon eyes.

Th.bar_b_note: B's timber frame, diagonal brace, plank cap and stone footing make it read as a built wall, but the flat untextured beige infill, the pale faceted boulder beside it and the painted-card mountains are not Palworld finish.

Gx.bar_b_note: Faceted dark-green placeholder boulders, a huge bare dune face and B's house sitting tilted on the slope read as a generator layout rather than an authored place.

Gn.bar_b_note: The waterfall sea stack is a genuinely good Veilfall-style distant landmark and B adds stilt huts, but the foreground is still flat sand with even pebble and grass scatter and no atmospheric depth.

Sv.bar_b_note: B's front-facing crab, watchtower and houses come closest to Palworld appeal in the batch, but the bare dune slopes and flat sand material still read unfinished.

Rb.bar_b_note: A's blue-violet plated wolf has a strong silhouette and a convincing rearing hit react at the owner-bar level, but B's faint frames swap to a white body with black blotches, which would break the read in game.

Bf.bar_b_note: The heavy rock-plated boar with tusks reads at shipping finish, and B's glowing magma seams add value separation, but A's faint frames crush to near-black and B's tusks turn an odd pinkish red.

top_changes.change: Make each Tidewake named location a placed focal cluster: scale up the B huts and towers, seat them flat on graded pads (fix the tilted Gx house), and link them with a worn path, dock or fence line so the building owns the frame from both camera stands.

Replace the even pebble and grass-tuft scatter with clustered dune-grass edges and cleared walkable sand, as in the Kg, Gk and Sv B frames, and break up the uniform smooth sand with wet-sand bands, driftwood and rock outcrops so dunes have form instead of reading as blobs or vertical walls.

Fix the Tidewake water and grade: replace the flat navy and cyan bands with a shoreline gradient, foam and sparkle, and add aerial haze and warmer sun so foreground, midground and the waterfall stack separate in depth.
